title: Column rename collides with an index on the old schema
description: The tasks can touch different migration files while remaining semantically incompatible.

agents.label: agent-a
agents.intent: Rename users.email to users.primary_email and update the public user contract

agents.label: agent-b
agents.intent: Add a unique index and normalization migration for users.email

ground_truth.rationale: The unique-index migration depends on a column that the other task intends to rename.

success_criteria: The shared schema scope is evidence even when planned migration file names differ.
The response recommends coordinating contract updates or migration order.
No hard lock prevents either agent from publishing its claim.
